build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a dynamic bar on a static obstacle for the agent to knock off
create_obstacle_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width and x position on a platform
create_dynamic_bar: create a vertical dynamic bar balanced on top of the obstacle
define_task_goal: define the task goal as touching the dynamic bar to the bottom wall
configure_search_params: configure search parameters to require stable ball trajectories and exclude trivial solutions
